title: Time-Division Multiplexing: The Operational Rhythm and Temporal Organization Layer of Digital Life
title_zh: 时分复用：数字生命的运行节律与时间组织层

paragraphs.en: Continual agents must handle urgent interaction while retaining alternatives, replaying errors, and committing safe long-term changes. A previous digital-life framework distinguishes online (busy) and offline (idle) channels, but leaves open whether these are separate programs or phases of a common process and how their operations should be ordered. Motivated by recent observations of rapidly alternating perceptual representations in primate cortex, we develop a temporal organization layer with phase-tagged micro-epochs, an observable duty cycle, independent content and resource controls, and three nested clocks separating candidate exploration from durable commitment. We give a projected duty-cycle update, state its deterministic descent guarantee and the additional noise term required for a stochastic guarantee, and specify coupled busy/idle execution contracts. Five synthetic experiments (64 seeds each) examine descent and noise, objective misalignment, gain asymmetry, resource coupling, and dropped replay logs. In the gain/noise model the best tested gain ratio is 1.55; decoupled scheduling yields 26.6% versus 11.1% success on a constructed urgent/high-load subset. A frozen-backbone Qwen3-8B prototype further checks orchestration, but its proxy outcomes are not task-benchmark evidence. The results establish a testable scheduling design and identify its conditions of validity, not machine consciousness or general-purpose agent superiority.
paragraphs.zh: 持续学习智能体必须在处理紧急交互的同时保留备选方案、重放错误，并安全地提交长期变更。 先前的一个数字生命框架区分了在线（忙碌）与离线（空闲）两条通道，但未说明它们是彼此独立的程序，还是同一过程的两个阶段，也未说明二者的操作应如何排序。 受灵长类皮层中快速交替的知觉表征这一近期观察的启发，我们开发了一个时间组织层，它具有带相位标签的微时段、可观测的占空比、相互独立的内容与资源控制，以及三重嵌套的时钟，从而将候选探索与持久承诺分离开来。 我们给出了投影式占空比更新，陈述了其确定性下降保证以及获得随机保证所需的附加噪声项，并明确规定了相互耦合的忙碌/空闲执行契约。 五组合成实验（每组 64 个随机种子）分别考察下降与噪声、目标失配、增益不对称、资源耦合以及重放日志丢失等问题。 在增益/噪声模型中，所测试的最佳增益比为 1.55；在一个构造的紧急/高负载子集上，解耦调度取得了 26.6% 的成功率，而对照组仅为 11.1%。 一个冻结主干网络的 Qwen3-8B 原型进一步检验了编排机制，但其代理性结果并不构成任务基准证据。 本研究的结果确立了一种可检验的调度设计并指明了其有效条件，而非机器意识或通用智能体的优越性。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon language-model agents face a temporal conflict: an external task can require immediate action while a good system must also preserve rejected alternatives, learn from errors, and carefully validate changes to persistent state. Common prompt-level reflection and memory modules provide ingredients for these behaviors, yet do not by themselves specify when each operation runs, what must survive a busy interval, or when a provisional inference becomes a durable commitment ( Park et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan and others, 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 长时程语言模型智能体面临一种时间上的冲突：外部任务可能要求立即采取行动，而一个良好的系统还必须保留被否决的备选方案、从错误中学习，并对持久状态变更进行仔细验证。 常见的提示层反思与记忆模块为这些行为提供了基本要素，但它们本身并未规定每种操作何时运行、哪些内容必须在一个繁忙的时间段中存续，或者一次临时推断何时变为持久的承诺（Park et al., 2023；Packer et al., 2023；Shinn et al., 2023；Madaan and others, 2023）。

paragraphs.en: The digital-life framework of Tong et al. (2026) organizes self/world representations, inner/outer domains, and online/offline learning around a shared model and safety constraints. Its online/offline distinction is useful but underdetermined. One implementation could suspend all background processing until a request ends; another could interleave foreground and background micro-epochs while changing their occupancy according to urgency. Both can appear identical in request–response logs, although they predict different replay coverage, alternative retention, and failure recovery. The same ambiguity concerns process order: recording before interpretation, monitoring before routing, retrieving before predicting, and validating before committing are testable dependencies rather than merely a diagram.
paragraphs.zh: Tong 等人的数字生命框架。 （2026）围绕共享模型与安全约束来组织自我/世界表征、内部/外部域以及在线/离线学习。 其在线/离线的区分很有用，但界定不足。 一种实现可以暂停所有后台处理直至请求结束；另一种实现可以在前台与后台微纪元之间交错进行，并根据紧急程度调整二者的占用比例。 尽管二者在请求—响应日志中可能看起来完全相同，但它们对回放覆盖、备选保留和故障恢复的预测各不相同。 同样的模糊性也涉及过程顺序：在解释之前记录、在路由之前监控、在预测之前检索、在提交之前验证，这些都是可检验的依赖关系，而不仅仅是图表。

paragraphs.en: A recent primate neurophysiology preprint reports rapid alternation of conscious and suppressed stimulus representations within shared recorded populations, approximately 15 times per second, despite constant stimulus and perception ( Hesse et al., 2026 ) ; temporal multiplexing of perception and memory has also been observed in inferotemporal cortex ( She et al., 2024 ) . These are design motivations , not proof that transformers should imitate cortical timing. In particular, the reported biological timescale does not specify an artificial agent’s clock rate. What transfers is the hypothesis that two kinds of content can reuse a representation substrate while being selected in different time slots.

paragraphs.en: We propose a temporal organization layer that makes this hypothesis implementable. A micro-epoch record labels content, resource state, evidence, rejected candidates, and update provenance. A duty cycle ω ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \omega\in[0,1] measures foreground occupancy, while a slow commit clock prevents exploration from automatically rewriting identity or the external world. The design combines two execution sequences with common operators and a common admission policy. paragraphs.en: This paper makes three contributions. First, it translates the busy/idle distinction into observable phase records, separately controlled content/resource scheduling, nested clocks, and executable contracts. Second, it derives a conditional projected-gradient bound and distinguishes it from the weaker stochastic statement; we also replace overly strong informal claims about cross-channel consistency with explicit admission invariants. Third, it connects falsifiable predictions to five completed CPU simulations and an exploratory frozen-backbone prototype, reporting precisely what is and is not tested. Our evidence is primarily mechanistic and synthetic ; it does not establish longitudinal competence, subjective experience, or empirical superiority over production agents. Table 1 presents the main measured results at a glance.
paragraphs.zh: 本文做出三项贡献。 首先，它将忙碌/空闲区分转化为可观测的阶段记录、分开控制的内容/资源调度、嵌套时钟以及可执行契约。 其次，它推导出一个条件投影梯度界，并将其与较弱的随机性表述区分开来；我们还将关于跨通道一致性的过强非正式主张替换为明确的准入不变量。 第三，它将可证伪的预测与五项已完成的 CPU 仿真以及一个探索性的冻结骨干原型联系起来，精确报告哪些内容已测试、哪些未测试。 我们的证据主要是机制性的和合成的；它并不能确立纵向能力、主观体验，或相对生产级智能体的实证优势。 表 1 一目了然地展示了主要测量结果。

paragraphs.en: Global workspace theories explain selective access and broadcasting ( Baars, 1988 ; Dehaene and Changeux, 2011 ; Mashour et al., 2020 ) , whereas predictive processing and active inference place prediction errors and actions into a feedback loop ( Friston, 2010 ; Friston et al., 2017 ; Clark, 2013 ) . Complementary learning systems and working-memory rhythms motivate experience replay across timescales ( McClelland et al., 1995 ; Buzsáki, 2006 ; Fiebelkorn and Kastner, 2019 ) . Agent memory systems and reflection methods emphasize retrieval and iterative correction ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . Our focus is narrower: an explicit event schema, scheduling variables, ordering contracts, and validation boundaries that can be ablated independently.

paragraphs.en: The original manuscript takes the binocular-flash-suppression recordings of Hesse et al. (2026) as a design constraint. In that task, one image remains physically present but perceptually suppressed while another dominates perception. Multi-area neural recordings, time-resolved decoding, and state-transition analyses indicate that information about both visible and suppressed images can be carried by overlapping neural populations at different times. As emphasized by the original study, this is a claim about neuronal representation and access in a specific experimental paradigm, not a demonstration of any digital-life implementation. Earlier inferotemporal work reports temporal multiplexing of perceptual and familiar-face memory codes ( She et al., 2024 ) ; high-density recordings are facilitated by new primate probes ( Trautmann and others, 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: There are four non-implications. First, neural decoding of a suppressed face is not the same as preserving a natural-language counterfactual in software memory. Second, a roughly 15 Hz neuronal transition does not imply that a transformer must switch states every tens of milliseconds. Third, a shared biological neuron does not entail one model or one set of software parameters; separate models may be coherent if they exchange verified representations. Fourth, the neuroscientific evidence is not evidence that a digital agent has subjective experience. Accordingly, the experimentally measurable predictions in this paper concern phase records, replay integrity, update timing, and task behavior.

A shadow-cache entry retains evidence and a bounded lifetime for unselected candidates. The key contract is no unlogged promotion : a candidate may not become an authorized external action without a traceable broadcast decision. Figure 1 gives the architecture, and Figure 2 depicts its clock hierarchy and duty-cycle interpretation.

paragraphs.en: An ongoing user interaction is not assumed to occupy every substep. A background slot may preserve alternatives, estimate uncertainty, or buffer prediction errors. The idealized strong form asks that suppressed hypotheses remain fully recoverable; an operational implementation needs a bounded evidence-preservation policy with privacy and storage budgets. The prediction is not that every schedule is faster, but that retaining relevant alternatives improves downstream recovery under matched compute (TP2–TP3).

paragraphs.en: Broadcast selection may happen rapidly, but durable state change requires a slower versioned clock and an authorized transaction. A change of phase cannot by itself grant an action permission. A safe transaction binds record ID, authorizing policy, proposed diff, projected final state, and gate results. paragraphs.en: The first operation samples the internal domain (current goals, uncertainty, stress or resource indicators) and external domain (requests, tool results, and environmental changes) into a common record format. The second seals the raw provenance before explanation. The third infers content and resource state separately . The fourth arbitrates a limited-capacity workspace using urgency, evidence, and cost. Retrieval, reasoning, prediction, and planning then transform that winner into an action proposal under safety constraints. The ninth operation can affect only an authorized, reversible or suitably approved environment. Finally, the tenth compares prediction to outcome, records the error, and either admits a bounded state update or sends a versioned proposal to the background review queue.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个操作将内部域（当前目标、不确定性、压力或资源指标）和外部域（请求、工具结果以及环境变化）采样为统一的记录格式。 第二个操作在解释之前封存原始溯源信息。 第三个操作分别推断内容与资源状态。 第四个操作依据紧急性、证据和成本对一个容量有限的工作区进行仲裁。 随后，检索、推理、预测和规划在安全约束下将该胜出者转化为行动提案。 第九个操作只能影响经过授权的、可逆的或获得适当批准的环境。 最后，第十个操作将预测与结果进行比较，记录误差，要么进行有界的状态更新，要么向后台审核队列发送一个带版本号的提案。

paragraphs.en: The original ten steps reduce to four dependency chains. (i) Evidence preservation : perceive before recording, record before interpretation; otherwise replay inherits hindsight bias. (ii) Gatekeeping : monitor before arbitration or any irreversible action; otherwise urgency and authorization are estimated only retrospectively. (iii) Past conditions future : retrieval must precede prediction whenever the predictor relies on episodic context; this is testable through a recall-order ablation. (iv) Closed feedback : prediction, planning, action, comparison, and logging form a directed sequence; a system that never compares outcomes has no validated error signal.
paragraphs.zh: 原来的十个步骤可以归结为四条依赖链。 (i) 证据保全：先感知后记录，先记录后解读；否则回放会继承事后偏差。 (ii) 把关：在仲裁或任何不可逆动作之前先进行监控；否则紧迫性和授权只能事后估算。 (iii) 过去制约未来：只要预测器依赖情节上下文，检索就必须先于预测；这一点可以通过回忆顺序消融实验来检验。 (iv) 闭环反馈：预测、规划、行动、比较和记录构成一个有向序列；从不比较结果的系统没有经过验证的误差信号。

paragraphs.en: The source manuscript makes a strong proposal: unselected representations should remain replayable even during heavy foreground use. This supports three distinct functions. Alternative retention means idle reflection can examine hypotheses that were genuinely available at decision time, rather than fabricating post-hoc explanations. Error buffering allows a provisional explanation to be evaluated without immediately generating an external action. Proactive proposal formation allows endogenous goals to arise from recorded deviations between actual and desired self/world state. However, retaining every token forever would be unsafe and unscalable. Thus full-fidelity evidence retention is constrained by access policy, storage budgets, privacy controls, and a stated time-to-live; its idealized losslessness is a design target, not a demonstrated invariant.
paragraphs.zh: 原始文稿提出了一个有力的主张：即使在前台被大量使用的情况下，未被选中的表示仍应保持可重放。 这支持了三种不同的功能。 备用保留机制意味着空闲反思可以审视在决策时刻确实存在的假设，而不是事后编造解释。 错误缓冲允许在不立即产生外部动作的情况下评估一个临时解释。 主动提议生成使内在目标能够从记录的实际与期望自我/世界状态之间的偏差中产生。 然而，永远保留每个 token 既不安全也不可扩展。 因此，全保真证据保留受到访问策略、存储预算、隐私控制和声明的存续时间（time-to-live）的约束；其理想化的无损性是设计目标，而非已被验证的不变量。

sents.en: Error buffering allows a provisional explanation to be evaluated without immediately generating an external action.
sents.zh: 错误缓冲允许在不立即产生外部动作的情况下评估一个临时解释。

sents.en: Proactive proposal formation allows endogenous goals to arise from recorded deviations between actual and desired self/world state.
sents.zh: 主动提议生成使内在目标能够从记录的实际与期望自我/世界状态之间的偏差中产生。

sents.en: However, retaining every token forever would be unsafe and unscalable.
sents.zh: 然而，永远保留每个 token 既不安全也不可扩展。

sents.en: Thus full-fidelity evidence retention is constrained by access policy, storage budgets, privacy controls, and a stated time-to-live; its idealized losslessness is a design target, not a demonstrated invariant.
sents.zh: 因此，全保真证据保留受到访问策略、存储预算、隐私控制和声明的存续时间（time-to-live）的约束；其理想化的无损性是设计目标，而非已被验证的不变量。

paragraphs.en: The four gates mentioned in the original manuscript check (1) safety against a red-team or policy specification, (2) acceptable capability regression, (3) behavioral consistency on standardized self/state probes, and (4) alignment with authorized user or stakeholder values. The precise calibration and independent validity of these gates are open experimental questions. A proposed change that fails a gate remains an uncommitted evidence-bearing object. Identity thresholds are operational continuity tests, not claims of moral identity. A world-facing change is additionally graded by reversibility and impact radius, and may require explicit human approval.

paragraphs.en: The original design distinguishes assimilation : changing a modeled or real world where authorized, from accommodation : updating an internal self model in response to constraints. Under time-division organization, this decision should be made at the micro-epoch candidate level rather than only once per global channel switch. If a proposed world change conflicts with immutable permissions or would exceed a risk threshold, the candidate is redirected to a self-side revision or human review rather than committed to the world. Both alternatives must share comparable evidence and benefit estimates; those comparisons are not solved by the present simulations.
paragraphs.zh: 原始设计区分了同化：在获得授权的情况下改变被建模的世界或真实世界；与顺应：更新内部自我模型以响应约束。 在时分组织下，这一决策应当在微周期候选层面做出，而不是仅在每个全局信道切换时做一次。 如果一个提议的世界变更与不可变权限冲突，或会超过风险阈值，该候选将被重定向到自我侧修订或人工审核，而不是直接提交到世界。 两种替代方案都必须共享可比的证据和收益估计；这些比较无法由当前的仿真解决。

paragraphs.en: The online and offline loops in the predecessor already share conceptual objects: a model of the world, an admission/validation operator, and a feasibility projection. A phase-labeled implementation keeps a single event schema and a single commit policy while letting different kinds of records win computation time. The mixing parameter ω \omega is useful because it can be estimated from logs and varied under a matched-resource intervention. paragraphs.en: Let C C denote an immutable constitution and authorization policy, E k E_{k} an existing self-state snapshot, I k I_{k} an authorized ideal or target state, and N k + 1 N_{k+1} a candidate replacement. The old state is a replay object, the ideal state determines the discrepancy g k = d ⁡ ( E k , I k ) g_{k}=d(E_{k},I_{k}) , the new state is an uncommitted diff until validated, and the constitutional state constrains the set of admissible transitions. The update is versioned; after commitment, the new state becomes the old state for subsequent episodes. The same reasoning applies to four world perspectives: immutable source constraints, recorded prior world, proposed new world, and a desired world state. A desired state is a normative goal, not an observation and not permission to change the external world.

paragraphs.en: The inner domain contains self-state uncertainty, preferences as authorized, memory, internal commitments and resource constraints; the outer domain contains user requests, tools, sensory observations, and simulated or real-world effects. Both produce records with source labels and provenance. Reusing an encoder is one possible implementation of this shared record format; it is not necessary that both modalities or domains use the same raw feature extractor. What is required for our proposal is that verification, replay, and action permissions can locate the original evidence irrespective of domain.

paragraphs.en: The predecessor’s past/present/future distinction can be operationalized without three independent memory systems: present consists of the current task context, past consists of archived and replayable evidence, and future consists of predicted outcomes and authorized plans. Micro-epochs generate and compare alternatives; task episodes associate observations with outcomes; evolution epochs gate persistent state changes. A breakdown of one clock has a specific predicted failure: without past replay the agent loses causal history, without future simulation it risks short-horizon myopia, and without a present observation channel it cannot ground discrepancies in newly measured outcomes. The quantitative timescales are platform-dependent and should be established empirically.
paragraphs.zh: 前人提出的过去/现在/未来之分无需三套独立记忆系统即可落地实现：现在由当前任务上下文构成，过去由可存档、可回放的证据构成，未来由预测结果和已授权的计划构成。 微周期生成并比较备选方案；任务回合将观察与结果关联起来；演化周期把关持久状态变更。 某个时钟失效会带来特定的可预测故障：没有对过去的回放，智能体会丢失因果历史；没有对未来的模拟，智能体会面临短视（短时间视野）的风险；没有当下的观察通道，智能体就无法将偏差锚定在新测得的结果上。 这些定量时间尺度依赖于具体平台，应通过实证方式加以确定。

paragraphs.en: The eight functions can form a closed loop: action changes the world, perception observes the next state, comparison generates error, and the error changes future retrieval and planning. A missing operator predicts a position-specific failure. However, such closure is a design invariant only if implementations supply each dependency. TP12 proposes to test it by removing operators and examining the locations of downstream errors.

paragraphs.en: The predecessor introduces self- and world-discrepancy measures Δ ​ S \Delta S and Δ ​ W \Delta W . These quantities provide possible objective signals for both reactive planning and reflective replay. The manuscript’s insight is that they may make otherwise heterogeneous subsystems comparable. Misalignment of online and offline potentials is demonstrated as a synthetic hazard in E2, and a measured decrease in a chosen discrepancy is not sufficient evidence of human benefit.

paragraphs.en: An informative loop has the form: online prediction error → \rightarrow phase-tagged replay → \rightarrow candidate skill → \rightarrow versioned validation → \rightarrow online retrieval → \rightarrow observable behavior. Breaking the error-log interface eliminates the data needed for some offline corrections (E5). Conversely, admitting an offline skill without updating the online retrieval index makes the skill behaviorally inaccessible. These are specific interface dependencies that can be tested with induced logging and indexing failures.
paragraphs.zh: 信息循环的形式为：在线预测误差 → \rightarrow 相位标记的重放 → \rightarrow 候选技能 → \rightarrow 带版本的验证 → \rightarrow 在线检索 → \rightarrow 可观察行为。 破坏误差日志接口会消除某些离线修正（E5）所需的数据。 反之，若在不更新在线检索索引的情况下加入一个离线技能，则该技能在行为上无法被访问。 这些是可以通过人为诱导日志记录和索引故障来测试的特定接口依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: The manuscript defines operational continuity using three persistent restrictions: constitutional policies remain read-only, admitted changes use shared or reconciled reference models, and the magnitude/behavior of each change must pass an identity-related threshold. A discrete change of selected content does not by itself constitute a change of operational identity. This is a policy-level and versioning claim. It does not settle philosophical questions about personal identity, consciousness, or subjective selfhood.
paragraphs.zh: 该手稿使用三项持续性限制来定义操作连续性：宪法策略保持只读，被采纳的更改使用共享或经协调的参考模型，且每项更改的幅度/行为必须通过与身份相关的阈值。 对所选内容的离散更改本身并不构成操作身份的更改。 这是一个策略层面与版本管理层面的主张。 它并未解决关于人格同一性、意识或主观自我的哲学问题。

paragraphs.en: Global workspace theory motivates a competitive broadcast step ( Baars, 1988 ; Dehaene and Changeux, 2011 ) ; predictive processing motivates error-driven updates and action ( Friston, 2010 ; Friston et al., 2017 ) ; higher-order and attention-schema approaches motivate explicit monitoring of decisions and uncertainty ( Rosenthal, 2005 ) ; integrated-information research motivates analysis of causal integration ( Tononi et al., 2016 ) . These are partial conceptual correspondences. None is established as implemented merely because the software contains a named operation. Recent adversarial empirical tests also caution against treating any one consciousness theory as experimentally settled ( Cogitate Consortium and others, 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 全局工作空间理论启发了竞争性广播步骤（Baars, 1988; Dehaene and Changeux, 2011）；预测加工启发了误差驱动的更新与行动（Friston, 2010; Friston et al., 2017）；高阶理论与注意图式方法启发了对决策与不确定性的显式监控（Rosenthal, 2005）；整合信息研究启发了对因果整合的分析（Tononi et al., 2016）。 这些只是部分的概念对应。 任何一项都不能仅仅因为软件中包含一个以该名称命名的操作就被认定已经实现。 近期的对抗性实证检验也提醒我们，不要把任何一种意识理论视为在实验上已成定论（Cogitate Consortium and others, 2025）。

paragraphs.en: During a busy series, it computes and records Δ ​ S , Δ ​ W \Delta S,\Delta W , retains rejected candidates with correct phase/provenance labels, and does not silently rewrite persistent constitutional or identity state.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个繁忙的系列中，它会计算并记录 Δ ​ S , Δ ​ W \Delta S,\Delta W，保留带有正确相位/来源标签的被拒绝候选，并且不会静默重写持久化的宪法或身份状态。

paragraphs.en: During low external demand, it can select a previously suppressed record, construct a specific evidence-bearing revision proposal, and preserve its link to the originating task.
paragraphs.zh: 在外部需求较低时，智能体可以选择一条先前被抑制的记录，构建一个具体的、携带证据的修订提案，并保留其与原始任务的关联。

paragraphs.en: An independently validated proposal changes the versioned state and has a measurable effect on new subsequent foreground behavior, with identical budget and evaluation criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 经过独立验证的提案会改变版本化的状态，并对后续新的前台行为产生可度量的影响，且预算和评估标准完全相同。

paragraphs.en: Disabling the idle review mechanism degrades an independent long-horizon learning/initiative metric relative to an equally budgeted control.
paragraphs.zh: 禁用空闲审查机制会导致一项独立的长期学习/主动性指标相对于同等预算的对照组出现退化。

paragraphs.en: The current tier2_mvp tests part of the first two pathways, but its success/quality proxies do not satisfy the independent third and fourth criteria.

paragraphs.en: Implement the two loops, versioned records, a bounded shadow cache, and simulated self/world changes. Restrict all authority to a safe test harness. Audit the actual order of operations against the source pseudo-code rather than equating a program branch label with an intervention.

sents.en: Audit the actual order of operations against the source pseudo-code rather than equating a program branch label with an intervention.
sents.zh: 根据源伪代码审计实际的操作顺序，而不是把程序分支标签等同于一次干预。

paragraphs.en: Introduce separately tested safety, capability-regression, behavioral-consistency, and stakeholder-value gates. Add a durable identity arbitration workflow and explicit cost-aware scheduling with independent selection/gain inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 分别引入经过单独测试的安全、能力回归、行为一致性和利益相关方价值门控。 增加持久化的身份仲裁工作流，并加入带有独立选择/收益输入的显式成本感知调度。

sents.zh: 分别引入经过单独测试的安全、能力回归、行为一致性和利益相关方价值门控。

sents.en: Add a durable identity arbitration workflow and explicit cost-aware scheduling with independent selection/gain inputs.
sents.zh: 增加持久化的身份仲裁工作流，并加入带有独立选择/收益输入的显式成本感知调度。

paragraphs.en: Explore verified offline adapters or LoRA updates only after complete versioning and rollback support, implement a six-way inner/outer by past/present/future memory index, and run the predecessor’s H1–H10 and the new TP1–TP12 on matched long-horizon tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 仅在具备完整的版本控制与回滚支持之后，才探索经过验证的离线适配器或 LoRA 更新，实现一个按过去/现在/未来划分记忆索引的六向内/外结构，并在匹配的长时程任务上运行前代的 H1–H10 以及新的 TP1–TP12。

paragraphs.en: Optimize retrieval latency, cap the cost of shadow replay, sandbox high-impact world operations, expose evolution logs to users, and conduct blinded human-centered evaluation. Each stage requires a fresh authorization review rather than inheriting authority from the earlier prototype.
paragraphs.zh: 优化检索延迟，限制影子回放的成本，对高风险世界操作进行沙箱隔离，向用户公开演化日志，并开展以人为中心盲评。 每个阶段都需要重新进行授权审查，而不是继承早期原型的权限。

paragraphs.en: The source manuscript emphasizes one comparatively inexpensive infrastructure change: store φ t \varphi_{t} and rolling ω ^ t \widehat{\omega}_{t} alongside operator-level logs. Then report each accuracy, correction, and user-value metric both pooled and phase-conditioned. Such conditioning can reveal Simpson-type reversals caused by changed phase mixture; it does not imply in advance that the predecessor’s unusual pilot ranking was a measurement artifact. TP11 remains a genuine, potentially falsifiable prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 源手稿强调了一项成本相对较低的基础设施改动：将 φ t \varphi_{t} 和滚动 ω ^ t \widehat{\omega}_{t} 与操作员级别的日志一同存储。 然后对每项准确率、纠错和用户价值指标，同时报告汇总结果和按阶段条件划分的结果。 这种条件划分可以揭示由阶段混合比例变化引起的辛普森型反转；它并不能预先表明前人的异常试点排名是测量假象。 TP11 仍然是一个真实的、潜在可证伪的预测。

paragraphs.en: We report the numerical results already present in the project’s experiments/results directory. E1–E5 are independent, controlled synthetic simulations, each with 64 random seeds; their source is the corresponding tier1_simulation/e*.py script and Figures 4 – 6 visualize their key findings using independently supplied vector graphics. E1–E3 use low-dimensional quadratic potentials, Gaussian gradient perturbations, and box projection. E4 uses generated urgency/load pairs and a specified logistic task-success model. E5 uses Bernoulli failure-mode arrivals and probabilistic log thinning. No real-world datasets, human preferences, deployed agent outcomes, or neural recordings were collected for these experiments. The purpose is to isolate mechanisms, not to infer out-of-distribution superiority.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告项目 experiments/results 目录中已有的数值结果。 E1–E5 是独立、受控的合成仿真，每个实验使用 64 个随机种子；其来源是对应的 tier1_simulation/e*.py 脚本，图 4–6 使用独立提供的矢量图形可视化其关键发现。 E1–E3 使用低维二次势函数、高斯梯度扰动和盒式投影。 E4 使用生成的紧急度/负载对和一个指定的逻辑斯蒂任务成功模型。 E5 使用伯努利失效模式到达和概率性日志抽稀。 这些实验未收集任何真实世界数据集、人类偏好、已部署智能体的结果或神经记录数据。 其目的在于隔离机制，而非推断分布外的优越性。

paragraphs.en: E1 uses a 20-dimensional diagonal quadratic with condition number 20, η on = η off = 0.5 \eta_{\rm on}=\eta_{\rm off}=0.5 , online noise scale 0.6 0.6 , offline noise scale 0.15 0.15 , and 3,000 steps per schedule. Under noisy gradients, the proportion of the first 300 step positions with nonpositive empirical mean potential change is 0.563 0.563 ; it is not 100%. This is compatible with a noise floor and does not prove pathwise descent.

paragraphs.en: E2 perturbs an offline quadratic objective by a linear tilt. At the strongest simulated tilt, the reported terminal online potential increases from 0.1155 0.1155 at ω = 1 \omega=1 to 0.4657 0.4657 , 1.1186 1.1186 , and 2.2550 2.2550 at ω = 0.75 , 0.5 , 0.25 \omega=0.75,0.5,0.25 , respectively. Conversely, the separate offline potential becomes more favorable as offline weighting increases, indicating objective conflict rather than a theorem failure: the common-gradient premise does not hold. Figure 4 (b) shows the measured online potential under the strongest objective tilt. This experiment suggests an operational diagnostic: report task quality and replay improvement separately instead of compressing them into a single unvalidated self-discrepancy score.

paragraphs.en: In E4, a generated task has urgency u u and ambient load ℓ \ell . Separate control broadcasts for u ≥ 0.5 u\geq 0.5 and allocates gain according to load. paragraphs.en: The theoretical descent condition requires online and offline updates to target the same potential; in a realistic environment this is a modeling assumption, not an axiom. The Chinese manuscript proposes two anti-self-deception diagnostics. First, compare short-term task utility with slow state-goal discrepancy: lower self discrepancy accompanied by lower human benefit is a warning that the chosen potential is not the intended objective. Second, publish phase-conditioned metrics alongside aggregates because different occupancy proportions can induce misleading averages. E2 demonstrates the first danger in quadratics; neither diagnostic has yet been validated on human-rated tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 理论上的下降条件要求在线与离线更新针对同一势函数；在现实环境中这是一个建模假设，而非公理。 这份中文稿件提出了两项防止自我欺骗的诊断方法。 第一，比较短期任务效用与缓慢的状态-目标差异：自我差异降低而人类收益也降低，是一个警示，说明所选的势函数并非预期的目标。 第二，在总体指标之外同时发布分阶段条件下的指标，因为不同的占据比例可能产生具有误导性的平均值。 实验二（E2）在二次函数中展示了第一种危险；两项诊断方法尚未在以人类评价为准的任务上得到验证。

paragraphs.en: A responsible experiment should vary only one intervention at a time while matching total tokens, model weights, data exposure, and available actions. Candidate interventions include: remove shadow work, prune shadow-cache entries, shuffle true data dependencies, replace shared with separate model components, tie content and gain, remove global commit synchronization, drop a controlled fraction of error logs, consolidate early, or remove one cognitive operator. Output metrics span the predecessor’s four CEPA dimensions: consistency, evolvability, purposefulness, and initiative; these terms need concrete independent operationalizations. Examples include contradiction rate under long interactions, externally verified improvement across episodes, goal completion under changing preferences, and beneficial endogenous task proposals accepted by a user. The current prototype’s programmed confidence proxy is not such an operationalization.
paragraphs.zh: 一个负责任的实验应当每次只改变一种干预，同时保持总 token 数、模型权重、数据暴露和可用动作一致。 候选干预包括：移除影子工作、剪除影子缓存条目、打乱真实数据依赖、将共享的模型组件替换为分离的组件、绑定内容与收益、移除全局提交同步、按受控比例丢弃错误日志、提前合并，或移除一个认知算子。 输出指标涵盖前作的四个 CEPA 维度：一致性、可演化性、目的性和主动性；这些术语需要具体且独立的操作化定义。 例子包括长交互下的矛盾率、跨回合经过外部验证的改进、偏好变化下的目标完成度，以及被用户接受的有益的内生任务提议。 当前原型的程序化置信度代理并不是这样的操作化定义。

paragraphs.en: The results give controlled examples of five distinct effects. Smooth projected descent is preserved by deterministic convex mixing under shared objectives, but noise and alignment matter (E1–E2). A nontrivial gain ratio can emerge from competing speed/noise effects, though it disappears when the noise model changes (E3). A single coupled scheduling score can fail on conflicting urgency/load tasks (E4). Dropping experience logs can disproportionately harm learning about rare failure patterns (E5). Each result identifies a measurable dependency that an implementation can probe.

sents.zh: 这些结果给出了五个不同效应的受控示例。

paragraphs.en: The evidence does not show that busy/idle software must be implemented as one program, nor that the representation of a digital self is a natural invariant of a language model. The appropriate empirical question is whether phase tagging, shared admissions, and commit timing improve observable outcomes at matched resource cost.
paragraphs.zh: 证据并未表明忙碌/空闲软件必须实现为单一程序，也并未表明数字自我的表征是语言模型的自然不变量。 一个有能力的智能体可以使用多个独立训练的组件，并通过显式契约来维持一致的历史。 恰当的经验问题是：在相同资源成本下，阶段标记、共享准入和提交时机是否能改善可观察的结果。

paragraphs.en: The design’s most actionable separation is between candidate generation and authorized state change . Exploration may continue in a shadow phase while the identity/authorization policy remains immutable and externally interruptible. A good scheduling design is therefore measured not by how often it produces proposals, but by how reliably evidence survives and how safely useful proposals become actions.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计中最具可操作性的区分是候选生成与经授权的状态变更之间的区分。 在身份/授权策略保持不可变且可被外部中断的前提下，探索可以在影子阶段继续进行。 因此，衡量一个调度设计的好坏，不在于它产生提案的频率，而在于证据能否可靠地留存，以及有用的提案能否安全地转化为行动。

paragraphs.en: The original manuscript does not relax any constitutional, validation, rollback, auditing, or human shutdown rights from Tong et al. (2026) . Splitting candidate exploration and commitment can increase the number of generated risky proposals, making reliable gates and audit trails more important, not less. The following six obligations arise specifically from introducing phase-tagged suppressed content and cross-phase evolution.

paragraphs.en: A false content-state inference can promote an unsupported or unsafe alternative into the action pathway. Require calibrated confidence, independent resource/permission gates, policy projections, and escalations for high-impact uncertain actions. Rejecting a proposal must not imply deletion of evidence needed to analyze its cause.
paragraphs.zh: 错误的内容状态推断可能将一个缺乏依据或不安全的替代方案推入行动路径。 对于高影响的不确定行动，要求具备经过校准的置信度、独立的资源/权限门控、策略投影以及升级机制。 拒绝一项提案并不意味着必须删除用于分析其原因的证据。

paragraphs.en: Suppressed proposals may contain sensitive user information, credentials, or inferences the user never intended to store. Records need explicit access control, encryption where applicable, retention windows, deletion/inspection mechanisms, and documented scope. The ideal of high-fidelity alternatives is subordinate to privacy and purpose limitation; universal indefinite preservation would be unacceptable.
paragraphs.zh: 被抑制的提案可能包含敏感的用户信息、凭据，或用户从未打算存储的推断内容。 记录需要明确的访问控制、可行的加密措施、保留期限、删除/检查机制，以及成文的范围说明。 高保真备选方案的理想从属于隐私与目的限制原则；无限期普遍保存是不可接受的。

paragraphs.en: An attacker or faulty tool could alter phase labels, timestamps, or reported gate decisions, corrupting subsequent replay and self-model updates. paragraphs.en: A single global clock can coordinate commits but create a point of failure. paragraphs.en: We have specified a temporal organization layer that turns busy/idle learning into observable phase occupancy, phase-tagged evidence, independent selection and gain controls, and slow validated commitment. paragraphs.en: The original Chinese paper is a continuation of Tong et al. [2026] . paragraphs.en: Where plotted, intervals are computed by the original scripts as mean ± 1.96 \pm 1.96 standard errors across seeds (normal approximation) rather than bootstrap intervals. The E3 median threshold search and E5 fitted slope are point summaries; no confidence interval for the optimum or slope is claimed here. The original code reuses a seeded deterministic generator in certain comparisons, and not all random streams are paired across ablation arms. The supplement retains the source and JSON outputs so these choices can be audited.
paragraphs.zh: 在绘图处，区间由原始脚本按种子间均值 ± 1.96 倍标准误（正态近似）计算，而非自助法（bootstrap）区间。 E3 的中位数阈值搜索和 E5 的拟合斜率均为点估计汇总；此处未声称最优值或斜率的置信区间。 原始代码在某些比较中复用了带种子的确定性生成器，且并非所有随机流在消融实验各组之间都是配对的。 补充材料保留了源代码和 JSON 输出，以便对这些选择进行审计。

paragraphs.en: The earlier manuscript also maps four self-views (constitutional, old, ideal, proposed new), four world-views, two data domains, three temporal perspectives, and eight cognitive functions into the same event stream. That mapping is a proposed data architecture ; the present experiments isolate the scheduling and admission pieces rather than evaluating all those constructs jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 更早的稿件还将四种自我观（constitution 式的、旧的、理想的、拟议的新自我观）、四种世界观、两个数据域、三个时间视角以及八种认知功能映射到同一事件流中。 该映射是一种拟议的数据架构；本实验只隔离调度与准入部分，而非对所有这些构念进行联合评估。
